judgements.reason: Generic despair about broken plans; nothing on the breakup, anger or self-blame.
Fresh wound from a sudden wrench out of shared life; exactly this loss.
Losing what we bent our soul on, asking what comes next; framed on death.
Mistakes happen; stop moaning over past slips and go on. Directly meets relapse despair.
Half suggests giving up striving; ambiguous and could reinforce hopelessness.
Mirrors the daily resolve-and-relapse cycle exactly, but offers no way out.
Gloom that no change of scene lifts; needs a change of soul. Relevant angle.
Explains why pleasure dulls as attention slackens; analytical but illuminating.
On ennui and following your own genius for fresh prospects; a little brisk.
Don't torment yourself over an unalterable misfortune; useful, if a bit cold.
Sorrow of pouring all energy into something that fails and being unable to let go.
Losing heart at first failure; a hundred chances. Mocking 'city dolls' may sting.
Grief for a lost friend: every place hateful because he is not there.
Telling them to replace the friend rather than weep lands as dismissive today.
Twelve years of friendship are not lost; the past remains theirs. Comforting.
About will versus soul in raising a child; not the career-parent dilemma.
Bleak line about children as regrets; touches the fear but offers nothing.
Filial piety and love; off the person's dilemma.
Not postponing life, many chances; relevant to feeling a failure, if brisk.
Unused powers make one unhappy, then warns of conceit; could sting.
Ambition sees only those ahead, never those behind. Exactly this comparison.
Shares only the word 'mother'; nothing about conflict.
Says the only evil is their complaining; blames the person for a real bind.
Crying out to a mother in despair over faith; a different situation.
Painful treatment that ends in healing; hopeful, though they are tired of treatment.
Pain is bearable when you recall its limits and add nothing in imagination.
Suffering with no cure, borne through charity and trust; spiritual not bodily pain.
Celebrates solitude; may feel dismissive to someone who hates being alone.
Learn to walk alone and know yourself; a reframing worth reading.
Calls the isolated person selfish; they already try to reach out.
A baby in your hands changes you; responsibility brings out our best.
A mother on the mystery of the womb; loosely related, no help now.
Being lost and beyond help; shares the feeling but a different setting.
Revealing a friend's secret ends the friendship; speaks to one horn only.
Testing a friend's feelings; beside the dilemma.
What you owe a friend who turns out badly; relevant angle on the friend.
Blames the worker for excuses; off-target and would land badly.
Don't groan inwardly; only loosely about daily torment, slightly chiding.
Decide if the annoying person is worth enduring; fits, though leaving isn't open.
Years are not counted out in advance; be ready. Relevant but death-forward.
Why life looks short from age: speaks exactly to 'where did the years go'.
Ceasing old desires in age and living each day as complete; strong fit.
Questions whether the crowd's fun is real happiness; a useful angle.
Amusements hide quiet desperation; relevant, though dark.
Everyone else looks pleased; I alone seem listless and forlorn. Exact.
Asks the same questions about life's goal; opens the thought without answering.
This world is a means not the end; we all die yet take life as the goal.
Everyone seeks freedom from misery by many paths; a partial answer on purpose.
Don't condemn the world's wickedness, help it; relevant, slightly chiding.
Compassion for the suffering; only a loose link to being disheartened by the world.
If I am evil the world looks evil; implies the darkness is their own fault.
Doctrines and sects matter little beside spirit; speaks to 'does it matter'.
Submit your will to God's; not about converting for a partner.
Acceptance over tolerance; echoes 'why can't he accept me'.
The other as your sensitive self; too abstract for this betrayal.
A trusted friend who shared bread has turned against me. Exact feeling.
Revealing secrets destroys friendship; validates the hurt from the keeper's side.
Faith on authority is not faith; relevant to churchgoing out of habit.
Why leave church for its falseness when the street is as false? Directly on point.
Forms matter only while they express inner life; otherwise discard them.
Release from the clinging past, but framed on dying; off for this.
Don't be bitter at abuse or thrilled at honour; fits the anger-and-validation pull.
A way to drop resentment for past wrong; short but applicable.
Find beauty in love, not the mirror; speaks straight to the dreaded mirror.
Says sour thoughts make a sour face; blames their looks on their mind.
About others telling you you're unhappy; the misery here is self-inflicted.
'Pounds' means money; off-topic keyword match.
Body weight used as analogy for lifespan; unrelated and could sting.
Weigh your own feeling over others' remarks; fits the hurtful comment.
Worth that depends on others' opinion is wretched; exactly their question.
Half of life's troubles come from 'what will people say'. Direct hit.
Consult your own feelings rather than what others say; relevant angle.
Don't make a fortune first to be a poet later; go up garret now.
Trying many trades and landing on your feet; supports finding a way.
Youthful romance of life breeds disappointment; deflates rather than helps.
Ordaining from outside a child's thought fails; names the mistake, not repair.
Hollow consolation after a father's death; unrelated to guilt and estrangement.
Will against a child breeds resistance; soul wins love. Fits, past tense.
Prizing status makes others' promotions torment; explains the wife's reaction.
A tender moment of being talked to; unrelated to the cold response.
Addressed to the one passed over, not to the person who was slighted.
Dropping resentment over past wrong; fits, though the wrong was circumstance.
Same release of resentment, slightly more list-like framing.
Rid yourself of the opinion about poverty, not poverty; exactly their knot.
Says a son's death touched him no more than lost property; would wound.
Grief that darkens everything and makes the self a riddle; meets raw loss.
The one we love most dies and a voice asks what after; apt but brief.
Joy with bride and bridegroom imagery; devotional but celebrates.
For this I had been waiting long; the exact feeling after years of hoping.
A second birth through love and marriage; fitting image for the day.
About gossips who betray secrets; not about holding a happy surprise.
Shares the word 'secrets' only; beside the point.
Talk little, since conversation coaxes secrets out; practical for holding it in.
Watching a child fail and fail at walking, sustained by joy. Exact.
On forcing success or ceasing to strive; not about watching a child.
Failures are natural and the beauty of life; fits the parent's hope.
Puppies playing, struggles as play; matches the light, exasperated tone.
A hunted fox's riddle; nothing to do with a dog in a pool.
Swimmer among drowning men; a wry surface match only.
Dying to learn life is inexhaustible; a word match with a different meaning.
Worn down by life's wear and tear with no pause; fits the exhaustion.
Weary with groaning, but about grief and enemies, not tiredness.
Losing toes and no longer minding; unrelated to sore feet.
'Feet almost gone' means moral slipping; keyword only.
Shoes beyond the foot's need; a wry nod to high heels at best.
